meta.name: git-worktrees
meta.description: Creates git worktrees for parallel development. Use when creating a git worktree, setting up multiple working directories, or working on features in parallel.

copy.tagline: 同时处理多个开发分支，互不干扰
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不同功能分支间快速切换
copy.tagline_en: Work on multiple branches simultaneously without conflicts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to juggle multiple git branches at once

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以管理 git worktrees，在项目同级目录下创建专用工作树文件夹，按约定命名分支和目录，支持并行开发。提供创建、列出和清理 worktrees 的命令。
howto.when: 当你要求创建 git worktree、设置多个工作目录或进行并行开发时触发。

say.text: 帮我为 feature-a 创建一个 worktree
say.note: 会创建分支并添加工作树

say.text: 清理掉 feature-a_1 这个 worktree
say.note: 会移除 worktree 并删除分支

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage git worktrees. It creates a dedicated worktrees directory beside the project, names directories and branches following conventions, and supports parallel development. It provides commands to create, list, and clean up worktrees.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a git worktree, set up multiple working directories, or work on features in parallel.
